text:
alex w: Heads-up — opened a docs PR to tighten up the rate-limit & quota pages, fix a broken dashboard link, and migrate the Python SDK snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 :eyes:

maria g: Thanks — which pages are you changing?

alex w: docs/pricing/rate-limits.md, docs/usage/metering.md, and docs/integrations/sdk-python.md. Also a small callout on the pricing tiers page about quota resets.

samir: I noticed the dashboard link in metering.md was 404ing earlier today. Looks like the panel id changed after the recent dashboards refactor. Old link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/usage?panel=token-meter -> new path is /dashboards/usage?panel_id=tm-02. I can update the URL in the PR.

olivia: SDK snippet needs the new client API. Current snippet uses `client.generate(...)` which we deprecated. New code should be `client.text.generate(...)` and show streaming example. Example to paste: ```python
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=REDWOOD_KEY)
resp = client.text.generate(model="rwd-small-v1", input="Summarize this report", max_tokens=120)
print(resp.output_text)
```

jamie: Can we also add a tiny section about burst behavior? People keep assuming rate limits are per-second exact. Suggest: "Burst capacity is applied per minute and is consumed from the customer's burst bucket; short spikes may be allowed but sustained overages will be throttled."

alex w: Yes — add a short example showing how a 200 req/min soft burst maps to 3 req/sec sustained for 1 minute. Also add explicit note that quota resets follow UTC midnight. That helped a customer yesterday.

docs-bot: PR #412 opened by alex w — automated link-checker found 1 broken link and 2 missing code-sample warnings. See CI details: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/98765

samir: I pushed a commit that replaces the dashboard link and updates the panel_id param in the metering page. Also updated the anchor so deep-links still work. Commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/9f3b2b7

olivia: Pushed the new Python snippet and added a short note about token rounding. Example text: "Metering is counted in 10-token buckets for text generation; usage is rounded up to the next bucket at invoice time."

jamie: Small copy tweak on the burst paragraph: change "short spikes" -> "brief spikes (under 60s)". Also add :wave: to the top of the quota reset note.

maria g: Quick nit: on pricing tiers page can we call out the per-minute meter name (token-minutes) and give a table row example? Otherwise LGTM from product docs side.

alex w: Great — can one of you squash/fix the CI warnings? The link-checker still flags one internal anchor on the rate-limits page.

samir: I'll run linkfixer locally and push a follow-up commit today.

olivia: CI is green after my snippet change and the panel fix. I left one comment about adding a tiny code comment to the snippet to clarify where to set `api_key`.

jamie: Approved the PR. :thumbsup:

alex w: Thank you everyone — merging after samir's link fix. I'll add a quick changelog blurb for release notes.

maria g: Nice work!
